items.q: That's right, it was Cutty, and Bill Stegmeyer on clarinet

ctx.x: Well, it did. And if you're acquainted with any of the great albums Lou made, God only knows I don't know who would have covered the situation any better.
We had on trombone at the time Cutty Cutshall, and I've got to research this for a moment. That's right, it was Cutty, and Bill Stegmeyer on clarinet, who I wasn't that ...
